notes.title: The Last Patch for Neon Parkour
notes.content:
We changed some logos, texts and fonts in the game. Neon Parkour is now a complete game. So, we are working on our future project(s). We'll announce the details when we're ready.

  Thank you for supporting us!

notes.title: The Sentinel Remake Steam page is now open to everyone!
notes.content:
We have come to the end of our long silence. The Sentinel Remake's Steam page is finally open to everyone! With this, we present to you the first snapshot of The Sentinel Remake.

The snapshots aren't targeting to show the gameplay, targeting to show The Sentinel Remake's graphic level. We wanted to show you that we are using the power of Unreal Engine 5.

Don't forget, The Sentinel Remake's first priority isn't graphics, it's gameplay. We will keep sharing images as time goes by. Don't worry, images aren't the only thing we will share. We are thinking of showing you the game by sharing gameplay videos in future.

So, everything is fine. We are working very hard as a team. We will let you know by development process goes on. Last of all, don't forget to add The Sentinel Remake on your Steam Wishlist!

A civilized man's struggle against a primitive world is about to begin.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794130/The_Sentinel_Remake/]Go to The Sentinel Remake Steam Page[/url]

notes.title: Neon Parkour - 1st Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Today is the [b]1st anniversary[/b] of Neon Parkour and we released v1.5 update for today.

  With this update;
  [b]+[/b] Added slowmotion
  [b]+[/b] Bugs fixed

  Thank you for your supports!

  [i][b]Aquila Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Neon Parkour Version v1 is now available!
notes.content:
Early access for Neon Parkour doesn’t exist anymore!

We ended the early access proccess for Neon Parkour with the 6 July 2021 v1.0 update
With v1.0 update:

-Bug fixes
-Some changes with UI
-New musics


Thanks For Your Supports,
[b]Aquila Team[/b]

notes.title: Neon Parkour Update v0.7.5 Released!
notes.content:
[b]Neon Parkour v0.7.5 is now available. With that update;[/b]
-Bugs fixed.
-New levels added. Neon Parkour has 40 levels now!

We are so close to full version.

[i]Thank you for your support,[/i]
[b]Aquila Team[/b]

notes.title: Neon Parkour Patch v0.2.7
notes.content:
[b]Neon Parkour Patch v0.2.7 is available now![/b]

+2 new soundtracks added to game.
